title: 150-line-per-file check script
prompt:
Write scripts/check_line_limit.py that walks packages/**/*.py, counts code lines excluding blank and comment-only lines, and exits non-zero listing any file > 150. Wire it into CI (0.8).

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.
note: Implemented scripts/check_line_limit.py to enforce PRD §3.2 (≤150 code lines per file). TDD: wrote tests/test_check_line_limit.py FIRST (count_code_lines excludes blanks/comments/docstring bodies; main() exits 0 on a clean tree, 1 listing offenders over threshold; --max-lines override honoured; DEFAULT_MAX_LINES == 150; live scaffold passes) — watched 8 fail (red), then implemented (green). Counting is token-accurate via stdlib tokenize: a physical line counts as code only if it bears a token that is not COMMENT/STRING/NL/NEWLINE/INDENT/DEDENT/ENCODING/ENDMARKER, so multi-line docstring interiors and comment-only lines are excluded while `x = "lit"` still counts. Threshold is a single named constant DEFAULT_MAX_LINES = 150 with a --max-lines CLI override (no scattered magic number). Output via stdlib logging (the workspace LOG surface is still a skeleton at scaffold stage; no external API calls in this build-time tool, so the gatekeeper is N/A). Script is importable (count_code_lines/find_offenders/main) and self-passes the check at 114 code lines. CI activation: the existing ci.yml forward-compatible guard (if [ -f scripts/check_line_limit.py ]) now runs the real script automatically — no workflow edit needed. Brought JUST this script into the lint/type gate: narrowed ruff extend-exclude from "scripts" to "scripts/create_issues.py" and added scripts/check_line_limit.py to mypy [tool.mypy].files, keeping the data-heavy create_issues.py generator excluded. Gates green: uv sync clean; ruff check . = All checks passed; ruff format --check . = 21 files already formatted; mypy = no issues in 21 source files; pytest --cov = 56 passed, 100% coverage (Required 85.0% reached); python scripts/check_line_limit.py exits 0 on the current tree. tests/test_lint_config.py has no assertion on the exclude value, so no reconciliation needed.
